messages:
ida: Quick concept: 30-min 'Launchpad Sprint' webinar — three 7-min micro-demos + 10-min live Q&A. Focus: actionable inference patterns teams can copy (latency/cost, quant guardrails, embedding search). Need speaker confirmations + 1-sentence abstracts by EOD Fri.
sam: I can take Demo 1 (latency/cost). Recommend reg form capture: primary_use_case and team_size. Also propose a trial coupon code `LAUNCH23` for attendees.
marco: I'll lead Demo 3 (customer embed search) — Maya can do the customer clip. Prefer Wed 9am PT rehearsal.
ava: Ops: prepare fallback plan (90s clip + cached outputs). We'll test streaming vs non-streaming in tech-check. Ill upload a 5-row test vectors CSV by Thu.
ops-bot: calendar event created: "Launchpad Sprint Tech-check + Rehearsal" Wed 2024-05-15 09:00 PT https://calendar.internal/evt/9988
maya: Happy to join for Demo 3. I'll share a 30s clip and a short customer blurb by Thu EOD. Rehearsal OK.
ida: Seed abstracts (please edit to 1 sentence):
- Demo 1 (latency): "How small changes to batching and prefix caching cut token spend without p99 regressions."
- Demo 2 (quant): "Rules for safe quantization: tests, guardrails, and rollback signals."
- Demo 3 (embeddings): "Embedding-first search with routing: a live customer case hitting sub-60ms answers."
sam: Lead routing: hidden field interest=[latency|quant|embeddings]; route `latency` -> SDR-A, others -> SDR-B. Add utm=launchpad_sprint. Export daily.
marco: Run-of-show draft:
00:00 Intro (ida)
02:00 Demo 1 - Latency/cost (sam)
09:00 Demo 2 - Quant & QA (sam)
16:00 Demo 3 - Customer (marco + maya)
23:00 Live Q&A
30:00 Close + CTA (trial + request demo)
ida: Also need three 3-line pivot scripts, 5+ edge-case prompts per demo, and separate audio tracks for recording.
ava: Confirmed. Ops will capture separate tracks and create a 2-min highlight clip post-event.
ida: Great. Marketing Ops: please wire the segmented reg exports to SDR queues and set conversion events: webinar_registered, highlight_clicked, lead_assigned. :thumbsup:
